_base_building_drone_range_i.title: Construction Drone Range I
_base_building_drone_range_i.description: Increases the range of the construction drone by 20 voxels.

_base_building_drone_range_ii.title: Construction Drone Range II
_base_building_drone_range_ii.description: Increases the range of the construction drone by 20 voxels.

_base_building_drone_range_iii.title: Construction Drone Range III
_base_building_drone_range_iii.description: Increases the range of the construction drone by 20 voxels.

_base_building_drone_range_iv.title: Construction Drone Range IV
_base_building_drone_range_iv.description: Increases the range of the construction drone by 20 voxels.

_base_building_drone_range_v.title: Construction Drone Range V
_base_building_drone_range_v.description: Increases the range of the construction drone by 20 voxels.

_base_character_logistics_slots_i.title: Resupply Slots I
_base_character_logistics_slots_i.description: Unlocks more resupply slots for the character.

_base_character_logistics_slots_ii.title: Resupply Slots II
_base_character_logistics_slots_ii.description: Unlocks more resupply slots for the character.

_base_character_logistics_slots_iii.title: Resupply Slots III
_base_character_logistics_slots_iii.description: Unlocks more resupply slots for the character.

_base_character_logistics_slots_iv.title: Resupply Slots IV
_base_character_logistics_slots_iv.description: Unlocks more resupply slots for the character.

_base_character_logistics_slots_v.title: Resupply Slots V
_base_character_logistics_slots_v.description: Unlocks more resupply slots for the character.

_base_character_logistics_unlock.title: Xeno-Logistics System
_base_character_logistics_unlock.description:
The alien scrap provides insight on how to teleport items over short distances. Analysis will allow us to gain sufficient insight to make use of a technology we call Xeno-Logistics.

The system allows us to automatically resupply items from Xeno-Logistics Containers into the character inventory through Xeno-Logistics Towers.

This cannot be used to move items between machines and is no substitution for various factory logistics.

_base_charged_crystal_production.title: Charged Xeno-Crystal Production
_base_charged_crystal_production.description: Unlocks the Crystal Refiner which allows to energize Xeno-Crystals into Charged Xeno-Crystals, which brings us one step closer to unlocking their true potential.

_base_crystal_mining.title: Xeno-Crystal Mining
_base_crystal_mining.description:
We have found super-condensed veins of Xeno-Crystals inside the lava caves. Similar to the Scrap-Mining we could utilize a specialized mining building to mine Xeno-Crystals from a seemingly endless source.

This also unlocks tracking of such deposits with the Short Range Scanner.

_base_crystal_ore_refinement.title: Crystal Ore Refinment
_base_crystal_ore_refinement.description: In case we have excess crystals we could blend them with the ore rubble to reduce our ore consumption.

_base_double_jump.title: Rocket Boots
_base_double_jump.description: Upgrades the player character with rocket boots which allow double jumping by jumping again mid-air.

_base_drill_shape_2x2.title: Drill Shape: 2x2
_base_drill_shape_2x2.description: Allows to dig multiple blocks at once with the mining drill. Hold right mouse button (default key) to switch the drill shape.

_base_drill_shape_3x3.title: Drill Shape: 3x3
_base_drill_shape_3x3.description: Allows to dig multiple blocks at once with the mining drill. Hold right mouse button (default key) to switch the drill shape.

_base_drill_shape_4x4.title: Drill Shape: 4x4
_base_drill_shape_4x4.description: Allows to dig multiple blocks at once with the mining laser. Hold right mouse button (default key) to switch the shape.

_base_drill_shape_5x5.title: Drill Shape: 5x5
_base_drill_shape_5x5.description: Allows to dig multiple blocks at once with the mining laser. Hold right mouse button (default key) to switch the shape.

_base_drill_ship_i.title: Drill Ship
_base_drill_ship_i.description: Unlocks the Drill Ship, which is a tunnel boring vehicle. It excels at digging tunnels, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

_base_mining_laser.title: Mining Laser
_base_mining_laser.description: A powerful mining laser that allows mining from a distance.

_base_personal_mining_drone_count_i.title: Excavation Drone Count I
_base_personal_mining_drone_count_i.description: Unlocks two additional personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_count_ii.title: Excavation Drone Count II
_base_personal_mining_drone_count_ii.description: Unlocks two additional personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_count_iii.title: Excavation Drone Count III
_base_personal_mining_drone_count_iii.description: Unlocks two additional personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_count_iv.title: Excavation Drone Count IV
_base_personal_mining_drone_count_iv.description: Unlocks two additional personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_count_v.title: Excavation Drone Count V
_base_personal_mining_drone_count_v.description: Unlocks two additional personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_i.title: Excavation Drone Speed I
_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_i.description: Increases the movement speed of the personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_ii.title: Excavation Drone Speed II
_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_ii.description: Increases the movement speed of the personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_iii.title: Excavation Drone Speed III
_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_iii.description: Increases the movement speed of the personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_iv.title: Excavation Drone Speed IV
_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_iv.description: Increases the movement speed of the personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_v.title: Excavation Drone Speed V
_base_personal_mining_drone_speed_v.description: Increases the movement speed of the personal excavation drones. Use the Excavation Drone Controller handheld to command them.

_base_personal_mining_drones.title: Personal Excavation Drones
_base_personal_mining_drones.description: Unlocks personal excavation drones and their handheld controller. This tool allows you to designate mining areas. Once marked, those areas will be dug up by your personal excavation drones as long as you're close enough.

_base_power_core_crafting.title: Xeno Power Core Manufacturing
_base_power_core_crafting.description: With the all the previous information we have previously gathered, we should now be able to make our own Xeno Power Cores.

_base_quarry_building_i.title: Quarry
_base_quarry_building_i.description: Unlocks the Quarry, a building which is able to excavate areas. It excels at digging shafts or pits, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

_base_scrap_mining.title: Xeno-Scrap Mining
_base_scrap_mining.description:
We have found super-condensed masses of Xeno-Scrap underground and we can utilize a specialized mining building to mine Xeno-Scrap from a seemingly endless source.

This also unlocks tracking of such deposits with the Short Range Scanner.

_base_scrap_recycling.title: Scrap Recycling
_base_scrap_recycling.description: Unlocks the Scrap Recycler which allows to recycle Xeno-Scrap into components we can repurpose for other needs.

_base_short_range_scanner.title: Short Range Scanner
_base_short_range_scanner.description:
Unlocks the Short Range Scanner, which allows us to track and locate Xeno-Scrap-Remnants on the surface.

Once unlocked, the scanner will appear at the top left of the screen.

_base_short_range_scanner_crystals.title: Crystal-Scanning
_base_short_range_scanner_crystals.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track Xeno-Crystals.

Note: Scan range might not be high enough to detect Xeno-Crystals from the surface.

_base_short_range_scanner_power_core_ii.title: Xeno Power Core Scanning
_base_short_range_scanner_power_core_ii.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track intact Xeno Power Cores.

Note: Scan range might not be high enough to detect those buried pieces from the surface.

_base_short_range_scanner_scrap_ii.title: Large Xeno-Scrap Scanning
_base_short_range_scanner_scrap_ii.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track larger Xeno-Scrap pieces, which may contain damaged Xeno Power Cores.

Note: Large Xeno-Scrap can be tracked from the surface, but you'll have to explore a bit until you get close enough. Open your scanning frame (default key: J) to customize which objects the Short Range Scanner should track.

_base_short_range_scanner_surface_caves.title: Cave-Scanning
_base_short_range_scanner_surface_caves.description:
Tunes the short range scanner so that it can track Xeno-Scrap pieces buried in underground caves where we will be able to find a lot more scrap in a more condensed area.

Open your scanning frame (default key: J) to customize which objects the Short Range Scanner should track.

_base_water_tool.title: Irrigation Tool
_base_water_tool.description: The Irrigation Tool shoots a stream of water which allows you to regrow grass on dirt terrain.

_base_al_end_consumer_i.name: Assembly Line Logistics Container
_base_al_end_consumer_i.description: Use this to store finished robots at the factory instead of shipping them to the station. Only useful if you want to put robots into workstations.

_base_battery_i.name: Batarya (Küçük)
_base_battery_i.description: Stores power from the connected High-Voltage Grid and releases it when necessary.

_base_battery_ii.name: Batarya (Büyük)
_base_battery_ii.description: Stores power from the connected High-Voltage Grid and releases it when necessary.

_base_biomass_burner.name: Biyokütle Brülör
_base_biomass_burner.description: Burns Biomass to provide low voltage power to the foundation it is placed on.

_base_blast_furnace_base.name: Yüksek Fırın Temeli
_base_blast_furnace_base.description: Requires Hot Air, Coked Ignium, Mineral Rock and Xenoferrite/Technum Ore to produce Molten Metals, which are processed by Casting Machines or the Heavy Caster. Produces Slag as waste product which is processed by Chemical Processors.

_base_boiler_i.name: Kazan
_base_boiler_i.description: Burns fuel to generate Steam from Water, which can be used to power Steam Turbines.

_base_building_part.name: Yapı Taşı
_base_building_part.description: Most buildings require Building Blocks as a foundation. Building blocks also conduct low voltage power.

_base_burner_generator_lvg.name: Brülör Jeneratörü
_base_burner_generator_lvg.description: Burns various fuel items to provide low voltage power to the foundation it is placed on.

_base_casting_building_base.name: Heavy Caster Base
_base_casting_building_base.description: Used together with the Blast Furnace to process molten metals.

_base_construction_drone_port_i.name: Construction Ship Port
_base_construction_drone_port_i.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Houses construction ships that assemble Modular Buildings once enough materials have been delivered to the construction site.

_base_construction_warehouse_i.name: İnşaat Dronu Deposu
_base_construction_warehouse_i.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Stores materials that will be picked up by transport ships for delivery to construction sites.

_base_conveyor_balancer_i.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici I
_base_conveyor_balancer_i.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

_base_conveyor_balancer_ii.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici II
_base_conveyor_balancer_ii.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

_base_conveyor_balancer_iii.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici III
_base_conveyor_balancer_iii.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

_base_conveyor_balancer_iv.name: Conveyor Balancer IV
_base_conveyor_balancer_iv.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

_base_data_source_button.name: Data Source (Button)
_base_data_source_button.description: On button push the configured signals will be pulsed once.

_base_decor_window_modular_slope_edge.name: Decor (Windows Modular Slope Edge)
_base_decor_window_modular_slope_edge.description: Use these blocks to transition between straight and sloped modular windows.

_base_drill_bot.name: Drill Ship
_base_drill_bot.description: Tunnel boring vehicle. Excels at digging tunnels, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

_base_drone_controller.name: Excavation Drone Controller
_base_drone_controller.description: Use this tool to mark areas for excavation by either your personal mining drones or the modular building construction ships (not unlocked together).

_base_drone_miner_i.name: Drone Madencisi I
_base_drone_miner_i.description: Mines ore patches when placed close to them. Cannot mine the larger ore veins.

_base_drone_miner_ii.name: Drone Madencisi II
_base_drone_miner_ii.description: Mines ore patches when placed close to them. Cannot mine the larger ore veins.

_base_drone_transport_startpad_i.name: Cargo Shuttle Start Pad
_base_drone_transport_startpad_i.description: Transports items to a Cargo Shuttle Target Pad of your choice. For planetary transport only.

_base_drone_transport_startpad_liquid_i.name: Cargo Shuttle Start Pad (Liquids)
_base_drone_transport_startpad_liquid_i.description: Transports items to a Cargo Shuttle Target Pad of your choice. For planetary transport only.

_base_drone_transport_targetpad_i.name: Cargo Shuttle Target Pad
_base_drone_transport_targetpad_i.description: Receives items from Cargo Shuttle Start Pads. Can receive from multiple Start Pads. For planetary transport only.

_base_drone_transport_targetpad_liquid_i.name: Cargo Shuttle Target Pad (Liquids)
_base_drone_transport_targetpad_liquid_i.description: Receives items from Cargo Shuttle Start Pads. Can receive from multiple Start Pads. For planetary transport only.

_base_elevator_i.name: Asansör
_base_elevator_i.description: Character elevator which also conducts high voltage power between all stations. Once placed, configure the other stations from its screen panel. Can automatically dig out the elevator shaft.

_base_endless_miner_crystals_i.name: Xeno-Crystal-Extractor
_base_endless_miner_crystals_i.description: Mines Xeno-Crystals when placed on top of a crystal deposit. Xeno Power Cores and Robot Workstations can be used to increase its output drastically.

_base_endless_miner_scrap_i.name: Xeno-Scrap-Extractor
_base_endless_miner_scrap_i.description: Mines Xeno-Scrap when placed on top of a scrap deposit. Xeno Power Cores and Robot Workstations can be used to increase its output drastically.

_base_exploration_analyzer.name: Omni-Analyzer
_base_exploration_analyzer.description: Allows to analyze collectibles like scrap and crystals to unlock upgrades.

_base_explosives_i.name: Patlayıcı
_base_explosives_i.description: Precursor item for remotely detonated charges.

_base_firmarlite_bar.name: Firmarlite Bar
_base_firmarlite_bar.description: Made from Firmarlite Bars in a Lava Smelter.

_base_flare_stack.name: Gaz İmha Çıkışı
_base_flare_stack.description: Destroys any liquid/gas inserted. Primarily used for burning of waste products.

_base_fracking_tower_base.name: Kırma Kulesi Temel
_base_fracking_tower_base.description: Needs to be placed on top of an ore vein to convert it into an infinite ore source. Requires Fracking Liquid.

_base_freight_elevator_i.name: Yük Asansörü I
_base_freight_elevator_i.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

_base_freight_elevator_ii.name: Yük Asansörü II
_base_freight_elevator_ii.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

_base_freight_elevator_iii.name: Yük Asansörü III
_base_freight_elevator_iii.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

_base_freight_elevator_iv.name: Freight Elevator IV
_base_freight_elevator_iv.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

_base_geothermal_generator_i.name: Geothermal Boiler
_base_geothermal_generator_i.description: Consumes Ignium-Enriched Water to create Steam for Steam Turbines. Needs to be placed on a Geothermal Vent.

_base_loader_1st_i.name: Yükleyici
_base_loader_1st_i.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

_base_loader_1st_i_filter.name: Filtreli Yükleyici
_base_loader_1st_i_filter.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output. Supports configuring a filter item type, and will then only move the set item type.

_base_loader_2nd_i.name: Yükleyici (İkinci Hat)
_base_loader_2nd_i.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

_base_loader_3rd_i.name: Yükleyici (Üçüncü Hat)
_base_loader_3rd_i.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

_base_logistics_tower_i.name: Xeno-Logistics Tower
_base_logistics_tower_i.description: Extends the coverage of your Xeno-Logistics Network, which teleports requested items from Xeno-Logistics-Containers into your inventory. Item requests can be configured at your inventory frame.

_base_mb_planner.name: Modüler İnşa Planlayıcısı
_base_mb_planner.description: Required to construct and configure Modular Buildings.

_base_modular_fluid_tank_base.name: Modular Storage Tank Base
_base_modular_fluid_tank_base.description: Stores large amounts of liquids or gases.

_base_orbital_uplink.name: Orbital Uplink
_base_orbital_uplink.description: Allows for remote access to all of the Space Station's features.

_base_ore_vein_miner_i.name: Maden Damarı Kazıcı
_base_ore_vein_miner_i.description: Mines ore seams of Ore Veins. Cannot mine the smaller ore patches.

_base_paint_roller.name: Paint Roller
_base_paint_roller.description: Can be used to change the color of certain objects and buildings that support this feature.

_base_personal_logistic_container.name: Xeno-Logistics Container
_base_personal_logistic_container.description: Stores items to be used for resupply in your Xeno-Logistics Network. See Xeno-Logistics Tower for more details.

_base_pipe.name: Boru
_base_pipe.description: Moves liquids or gases. Requires a pump when the pipe length exceeds the limit.

_base_pipe_intake_i.name: Liquid Intake
_base_pipe_intake_i.description: Draws in Water when placed submerged.

_base_pipeline.name: Boru Hattı
_base_pipeline.description: Moves liquids or gases at higher rates than pipes. Requires a pipeline pump when the pipeline length exceeds the limit.

_base_pipeline_intake_i.name: Liquid Intake (Pipeline)
_base_pipeline_intake_i.description: Draws in Water when placed submerged.

_base_plumber_tool.name: Sıvı Tesisat Aracı
_base_plumber_tool.description: Allows you to discard a pipe network’s contents.

_base_power_line_i.name: Güç Hattı
_base_power_line_i.description: Use this item to build your high-voltage power grid, also requires Power Poles in your inventory unless you just want to connect existing objects.

_base_power_pole_i.name: Elektrik Direği (Küçük)
_base_power_pole_i.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

_base_power_pole_ii.name: Elektrik Direği (Büyük)
_base_power_pole_ii.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

_base_power_pole_iii.name: Elektrik Direği (Duvar Tipi)
_base_power_pole_iii.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

_base_pump_pipe_to_pipeline_i.name: Pipe-to-Pipeline Pump
_base_pump_pipe_to_pipeline_i.description: Pumps pipe contents into a pipeline.

_base_pump_pipeline_to_pipe_i.name: Pipeline-to-Pipe Pump
_base_pump_pipeline_to_pipe_i.description: Pumps pipeline contents into a pipe.

_base_pump_pipelines_i.name: Pompa (Boru Hattı)
_base_pump_pipelines_i.description: Required once a pipeline network exceeds the complexity limit. Can also be used to create a one-way flow.

_base_pump_pipes_i.name: Pompa (Borular)
_base_pump_pipes_i.description: Required once a pipe network exceeds the complexity limit. Can also be used to create a one-way flow.

_base_pumpjack_i.name: Sondaj Pompası I
_base_pumpjack_i.description: Extracts Olumite when placed above an Olumite Reservoir.

_base_quarry_building_i.name: Quarry
_base_quarry_building_i.description: Automatically excavates areas. Excels at digging shafts or pits, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

_base_radio_tower_base.name: Radio Tower Base
_base_radio_tower_base.description: Allows contacting the space station remotely with the Orbital Uplink tool.

_base_recycler_terrain.name: Resource Separator
_base_recycler_terrain.description: Extracts resources from terrain blocks and seeds.

_base_research_entity.name: Araştırma Sunucusu
_base_research_entity.description: Analyzes Science Packs to research new technologies. Using multiple increases research speed.

_base_scanning_entity_i.name: Uzun Menzilli Tarayıcı
_base_scanning_entity_i.description: Scans for ores and reservoirs within a very large radius.

_base_shipping_pad_i.name: Shipping Pad (Small)
_base_shipping_pad_i.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

_base_shipping_pad_ii.name: Shipping Pad (Medium)
_base_shipping_pad_ii.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

_base_shipping_pad_ii_al.name: Shipping Pad (Medium, Assembly Line)
_base_shipping_pad_ii_al.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

_base_smelter_lava_i.name: Lava-Smelter I
_base_smelter_lava_i.description: Smelts Firmarlite Bars into Firmarlite Sheets. Needs to be placed on lava.

_base_smelter_lava_ii.name: Lava-Smelter II
_base_smelter_lava_ii.description: Smelts Firmarlite Bars into Firmarlite Sheets. Needs to be placed on lava.

_base_solar_panel_i.name: Güneş Paneli (Küçük)
_base_solar_panel_i.description: Generates high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid while exposed to sunlight.

_base_solar_panel_ii.name: Güneş Paneli (Büyük)
_base_solar_panel_ii.description: Generates high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid while exposed to sunlight.

_base_space_station_terminal.name: Space Station Terminal
_base_space_station_terminal.description: Contact your space station from here.

_base_train_loading_station.name: Train Loading Station
_base_train_loading_station.description: Loading Stations are extensions to Train Stations where a wagon can be loaded or unloaded. Each wagon needs its own loading station.

_base_transformer_i.name: Trafo (Küçük)
_base_transformer_i.description: When placed on a foundation, supplies it with low voltage power drawn from the high-voltage grid.

_base_transformer_ii.name: Trafo (Büyük)
_base_transformer_ii.description: When placed on a foundation, supplies it with low voltage power drawn from the high-voltage grid.

_base_transport_drone_port_i.name: Transport Ship Port
_base_transport_drone_port_i.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Houses transport ships that move materials from Construction Warehouses to construction sites.

_base_turbine_i.name: Buhar Türbini
_base_turbine_i.description: Consumes Steam to generate high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid.

_base_water_tool.name: Irrigation Tool
_base_water_tool.description: Can be used on various terrain blocks to regrow grass or similar features.

_base_workstation_i.name: Robot Workstation I
_base_workstation_i.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

_base_workstation_ii.name: Robot Workstation II
_base_workstation_ii.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

_base_workstation_iii.name: Robot Workstation III
_base_workstation_iii.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_insi.modeName: Window Slope Inside Corner Lower Left

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_insi.name: Decor (Windows Modular Slope)
_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_insi.modeName: Window Slope Inside Corner Lower Right

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_insi.modeName: Window Slope Inside Corner Upper Left

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_insi.modeName: Window Slope Inside Corner Upper Right

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_outs.name: Decor (Windows Modular Slope)
_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_outs.modeName: Window Slope Outside Corner Lower Left

_base_decor_window_slope_mod_corner_outs.name: Decor (Windows Modular Slope)

_base_admin_bot_i.name: Operator Bot Assembly
_base_admin_bot_i.description: Allows the production of Operator Bots.

_base_admin_robot_i.name: Operator Robot Assembly
_base_admin_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Operator Robots in assembly lines.

_base_advanced_firmarlite_smelting.name: Advanced Firmarlite Smelting
_base_advanced_firmarlite_smelting.description: This research unlocks an improved version of the Lava Smelter which is faster.

_base_advanced_steelmaking.name: Advanced Steelmaking
_base_advanced_steelmaking.description: Unlocks an improved steelmaking process to increase cost efficiency.

_base_agriculture_bot_i.name: Planter Drone Assembly
_base_agriculture_bot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce planter drones, used for agricultural tasks.

_base_agriculture_bot_ii.name: Hydro-Farming Bot Assembly
_base_agriculture_bot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Hydro-Farming Bots.

_base_agriculture_robot_i.name: Farmer Robot Assembly
_base_agriculture_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Farmer Robots in assembly lines.

_base_air_intake.name: Air Intake
_base_air_intake.description: Unlocks modular Air Intakes, which are a requirement for various other modular buildings.

_base_assembler_i.name: Montaj Makinası I
_base_assembler_i.description: Çeşitli bileşenler üretmekte kullanılan Montaj Makinası'nın kilidini açar.

_base_assembler_ii.name: Montaj Makinası II
_base_assembler_ii.description: Daha hızlı bir Montaj Makinası'nın kilidini açar.

_base_assembler_iii.name: Montajcı III
_base_assembler_iii.description: Daha da hızlı bir Montajcı'nın kilidini açar.

_base_assembly_lines.name: Montaj Hatları
_base_assembly_lines.description: Gelişmiş robotlar üretmek için Montaj Hatlarının kilidini açar.

_base_barrel_filler_i.name: Olumite Barreling
_base_barrel_filler_i.description: Allows to fill Olumite in barrels so that it can be handled as solid. Required for trading Olumite on the galactic market.

_base_basic_cmat_i.name: Construction Material
_base_basic_cmat_i.description: Allows us to make our own construction material for the space station.

_base_basic_cmat_ii.name: High-Tech Construction Material
_base_basic_cmat_ii.description: High-Tech construction material is used for advanced buildings and space station constructions.

_base_basic_olumite_processing.name: Temel Seviye Olumit İşleme
_base_basic_olumite_processing.description: Olumit madeninin polimer kartların yapımında kullanılan Sıvı Polimer'e rafine edilmesini sağlar.

_base_basic_steelmaking.name: Temel Çelik İşleme
_base_basic_steelmaking.description: Basit bir çelik üretim metodunun kilidini açar.

_base_biomass_farming.name: Biomass Farming
_base_biomass_farming.description: Unlocks automated biomass farming and a decorative wooden block. Note that biomass farming is energy inefficient and costs more power than it yields.

_base_blast_furnace.name: Blast Furnace
_base_blast_furnace.description: Blast furnaces provide a complex but highly efficient way of producing metallurgic goods.

_base_burner_generator_lvg.name: Brülör Jeneratörü
_base_burner_generator_lvg.description:
Daha verimli ve sürecinin otomatize edilmesi mümkün olan, daha büyük bir düşük gerilimli jeneratörün kilidini açar.

Brülör Jeneratörü Biyokütle yakabilir, fakat sürecin Ignium Madeni kazan Drone Madencileri ile otomatize edilmesi tavsiye edilir.

_base_character_improvement_i.name: Construction Drone
_base_character_improvement_i.description:
Unlocks the personal construction drone and five additional inventory slots.

The construction drone provides an alternative mode to place buildings from a flyable drone, which often is more comfortable than from the first person character perspective.

_base_chemical_processing.name: Kimyasal İşleme
_base_chemical_processing.description: Kimyasal elementler ve sıvılar için gelişmiş işleme makinalarının kilidini açar. Daha sonra gelecek olan bazı araştırmalar için ön koşuldur.

_base_circuit_board.name: Devre Kartı
_base_circuit_board.description: Devre kartları, daha gelişmiş elektronik bileşen ve makinaların üretimine imkan sağlar.

_base_cleaning_bot_i.name: Vacuum Bot Assembly
_base_cleaning_bot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce vacuum bots.

_base_cleaning_bot_ii.name: Cleaning Bot Assembly
_base_cleaning_bot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce cleaning bots.

_base_concrete_production.name: Beton Üretimi
_base_concrete_production.description: Beton hem zemin, hem duvar olarak kullanılabilir. Beton zeminler yürüme hızını arttırır.

_base_construction_drone_ports.name: İnşaat Endüstrisi
_base_construction_drone_ports.description: Büyük modüler binaların inşasında kullanılan İnşaat Dronu yuvalarının kilidini açar.

_base_container.name: Konteyner
_base_container.description: Large container to store items. This version cannot be automated with loaders and conveyors.

_base_conveyor_balancer_i.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici I
_base_conveyor_balancer_i.description: İki konveyör hattını birleştirmeye, bölmeye veya dengelemeye imkan sağlar.

_base_conveyor_balancer_ii.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici II
_base_conveyor_balancer_ii.description: Daha hızlı konveyör hatlarını birleştirmeye veya bölmeye imkan sağlar.

_base_conveyor_balancer_iii.name: Konveyör Dengeleyici III
_base_conveyor_balancer_iii.description: Daha hızlı konveyör hatlarını birleştirmeye veya bölmeye imkan sağlar.

_base_conveyor_balancer_iv.name: Conveyor Balancer IV
_base_conveyor_balancer_iv.description: Allows to split or merge two conveyor lanes with faster belts.

_base_conveyor_ii.name: Konveyör II
_base_conveyor_ii.description:
Daha hızlı kayışların kilidini açar.

Verim: 320 öğe/dk

_base_conveyor_iii.name: Konveyör III
_base_conveyor_iii.description:
Unlocks even faster belts. 

Throughput: 640 Items/min

_base_conveyor_iv.name: Conveyor IV
_base_conveyor_iv.description:
Unlocks even faster belts. 

Throughput: 1280 Items/min

_base_cpu_production.name: CPU Production
_base_cpu_production.description: Central Processing Units are required for various advanced technologies.

_base_data_cable.name: Data Cable
_base_data_cable.description: Unlocks data cables, which can be used for various logic operations related to machine behavior. Once unlocked, check the Info Database for more details.

_base_data_manipulation.name: Data Manipulation
_base_data_manipulation.description: Unlocks data cable system buildings that allow for arithmetic, logic and conditional operations, and a memory cell that allows to store a value.

_base_data_sources.name: Data Sources
_base_data_sources.description: Unlocks signal sources for the data cable system.

_base_decor_i.name: Dekor I
_base_decor_i.description: Bir dizi dekoratif blok ve bunları boyamak için bir boya rulosunun kilidini açar.

_base_decor_window.name: Dekor: Pencereler
_base_decor_window.description: Unlocks a set of windows and a set of objects to create custom window shapes.

_base_door_ii.name: Kapı (Çift Kanat)
_base_door_ii.description: Binalarınızda kullanabileceğiniz Çift Kapı kilidini açar.

_base_drone_miner_ii.name: Drone Madencisi II
_base_drone_miner_ii.description: Daha yüksek drone kapasitesi ve kazı hızı.

_base_dynamite_ii.name: Heavy Explosive Charges
_base_dynamite_ii.description: Heavy explosive charges have an increased blast radius and are able to clear lava cave bedrock and empty reservoirs.

_base_elevator_i.name: Asansör
_base_elevator_i.description: An elevator to transport characters up and down.

_base_emergency_beacon.name: Emergency Beacon
_base_emergency_beacon.description: By placing an emergency beacon we should be able to re-establish communications with mission control.

_base_escalators.name: Escalators I
_base_escalators.description: Yürüyüş hızınızı arttırmak için yürüyen merdivenleri kullanın.

_base_escalators_ii.name: Escalators II
_base_escalators_ii.description: Use escalators to increase movement speed.

_base_escalators_iii.name: Escalators III
_base_escalators_iii.description: Use escalators to increase movement speed.

_base_exploration_analyzer.name: Omni-Analyzer
_base_exploration_analyzer.description: Unlocks the Omni-Analyzer, which is used to analyze various rare artifacts like Xeno-Scrap found on this moon. Analysis then unlocks various upgrades.

_base_explosives_ii.name: Gelişmiş Patlayıcılar
_base_explosives_ii.description: Patlayıcı üretmenin otomatikleştirilebilir bir yolunu sağlar.

_base_firmarlite_smelting_basic.name: Basic Firmarlite Smelting
_base_firmarlite_smelting_basic.description: By smelting Firmarlite Bars into Firmarlite Sheets the material can be used for various purposes. It is especially useful in advanced manufacturing because Firmarlite is very lightweight yet sturdy.

_base_fracking_tower.name: Çatlatma Kulesi
_base_fracking_tower.description: Ore veins can be converted into infinite ore sources by the continous use of fracking.

_base_freight_elevator_i.name: Freight Elevator I
_base_freight_elevator_i.description:
A freight elevator that can be connected to belts (via loaders) to make transporting items along the vertical direction easier. 

Throughput: 320 Items/min

_base_freight_elevator_ii.name: Freight Elevator II
_base_freight_elevator_ii.description:
A freight elevator that can be connected to belts (via loaders) to make transporting items along the vertical direction easier.

Throughput: 640 Items/min

_base_freight_elevator_iii.name: Freight Elevator III
_base_freight_elevator_iii.description:
A freight elevator that can be connected to belts (via loaders) to make transporting items along the vertical direction easier.

Throughput: 1280 Items/min

_base_freight_elevator_iv.name: Freight Elevator IV
_base_freight_elevator_iv.description:
A freight elevator that can be connected to belts (via loaders) to make transporting items along the vertical direction easier.

Throughput: 2560 Items/min

_base_geothermal_power.name: Geothermal Power
_base_geothermal_power.description:
Unlocks the Geothermal Boiler which allows you to use Geothermal Vents in the lava caves to produce Steam at very high efficiency.
Also allows to scan for Geothermal Vents with the Ore Scanner.

_base_greenhouse_i.name: Sera
_base_greenhouse_i.description: Seralar kullanılarak bitki ve ağaç tohumlarının yetiştirilmesini sağlar.

_base_hazard_robot_i.name: Hazard Robot Assembly
_base_hazard_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Hazard Robots in assembly lines.

_base_high_voltage_energy.name: Yüksek Gerilim Şebekesi
_base_high_voltage_energy.description: Elektrik direkleri, transformatörler ve endüstriyel güç jeneratörleriyle bir yüksek gerilim güç şebekesi oluşturun.

_base_hover_engine.name: Hover Engine
_base_hover_engine.description: Hover Engines are required to produce flying drones. It opens up the path to multiple new robot types.

_base_ignium_fuel_rods.name: Ignium Fuel Rods
_base_ignium_fuel_rods.description: By enriching Ignium with Technum powerful fuel rods can be created.

_base_incinerator.name: Yakma Fırını
_base_incinerator.description: Yakıcı istenmeyen her çeşit objeyi yakarak yok edebilir.

_base_infrastructure_i.name: Temel Altyapı
_base_infrastructure_i.description: Lojistik Konteyneri (Yükleyici ve Konveyör ile kullanılarak otomasyon içerisine dahil edilebilen bir depolama ünitesi) kilidini açar ve gelecek altyapısal araştırmaların ön koşuludur.

_base_jetpack_speed_i.name: Jetpack Hızı I
_base_jetpack_speed_i.description: Artan yakıt tüketimi pahasına maksimum jetpack hızını artırır.

_base_jetpack_speed_ii.name: Jetpack Hızı II
_base_jetpack_speed_ii.description: Artan yakıt tüketimi pahasına maksimum jetpack hızını artırır.

_base_light_bot_i.name: Light Bot Assembly
_base_light_bot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce light bots.

_base_light_portable_i.name: Portable Light
_base_light_portable_i.description: Unlocks a portable light that doesn't require power.

_base_lights_ii.name: Işıklandırma II
_base_lights_ii.description: Karanlıkta daha da iyi görebilmek mi istiyorsunuz?

_base_lights_iii.name: Lights III
_base_lights_iii.description: Unlocks a larger ceiling light for your factory.

_base_loader_1st_i_filter.name: Filter Loader
_base_loader_1st_i_filter.description: A loader that requires configuration of a certain item and then will only move such items.

_base_loader_2nd_i.name: Yükleyici (İkinci Hat)
_base_loader_2nd_i.description: İki blok uzaktan/uzağa yükleme yapabilen bir yükleyici.

_base_loader_3rd_i.name: Yükleyici (Üçüncü Hat)
_base_loader_3rd_i.description: Üç blok uzaktan/uzağa yükleme yapabilen bir yükleyici.

_base_logistic_container_ii.name: Lojistik Konteyneri II
_base_logistic_container_ii.description: Eşya saklamak için daha büyük bir konteyner. Bu konteyner tipi konveyör ve yükleyicilerle otomatize edilebilir.

_base_logistic_container_iii.name: Lojistik Konteyneri III
_base_logistic_container_iii.description: Eşya saklamak için daha büyük bir konteyner. Bu konteyner tipi konveyör ve yükleyicilerle otomatize edilebilir.

_base_long_distance_transport.name: Cargo Shuttles
_base_long_distance_transport.description: Cargo shuttles provide a convenient way of transporting large amounts of goods over long distances. Cargo shuttles can only transport goods on the planet, they cannot reach the station.

_base_long_distance_transport_liquids.name: Cargo Shuttles (Liquids)
_base_long_distance_transport_liquids.description: Unlocks cargo shuttles that are able to carry liquids and gases. Cargo shuttles can only transport goods on the planet, they cannot reach the station.

_base_long_range_scanner.name: Uzun Menzilli Tarayıcı
_base_long_range_scanner.description: Uzun Menzilli Tarayıcı, uzak bölgeleri kaynaklar için otomatik olarak tarayan modüler bir yapıdır.

_base_medium_shipping_pad.name: Shipping Pad (Medium)
_base_medium_shipping_pad.description: A medium shipping pad allows us to land bigger ships on the planet.

_base_military_bot_i.name: Combat Drone Assembly
_base_military_bot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce combat drones.

_base_military_robot_i.name: Combat Robot Assembly
_base_military_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Combat Robots in assembly lines.

_base_military_robot_ii.name: Assault Robot Assembly
_base_military_robot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Assault Robots in assembly lines.

_base_mining_bot_i.name: Mining Drone Assembly
_base_mining_bot_i.description: Allows the production of Mining Drones.

_base_mining_bot_ii.name: Hydro-Mining Bot Assembly
_base_mining_bot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Hydro-Mining Bots.

_base_mining_efficiency.name: Kazı Verimliliği
_base_mining_efficiency.description:
Allows all mining machines to produce additional items without depleting their respective ore patch or vein. Produces 10% additional free ore items per level, can be researched infinitely. Does not increase the output per minute.

For ore vein core mining it reduces fracking liquid consumption. Each level grants 10% additional free ore items per same amount of fracking liquid required.

_base_mining_efficiency_demo.name: Kazı Verimliliği (Deneme Sürümü)
_base_mining_efficiency_demo.description:
Madencilik makinalarının çıktısını seviye başına 10% arttırır. Bu artış, maden yatağının daha hızlı tükenmesine neden olmaz. Tekrar tekrar araştırılabilir.

Bu deneme sürümünde bu artış madencilerin panellerine ya da tabletlere yansıtılmamıştır, fakat madencileriniz yine de daha fazla maden elde edecektir.

_base_mining_efficiency_i.name: Madencilik Verimliliği (1)
_base_mining_efficiency_i.description:
Allows all mining machines to produce additional items without depleting their respective ore patch or vein. Produces 10% additional free ore items per level, can be researched infinitely. Does not increase the output per minute.

For ore vein core mining it reduces fracking liquid consumption. Each level grants 10% additional free ore items per same amount of fracking liquid required.

_base_mining_efficiency_ii.name: Madencilik Verimliliği (2)
_base_mining_efficiency_ii.description:
Allows all mining machines to produce additional items without depleting their respective ore patch or vein. Produces 10% additional free ore items per level, can be researched infinitely. Does not increase the output per minute.

For ore vein core mining it reduces fracking liquid consumption. Each level grants 10% additional free ore items per same amount of fracking liquid required.

_base_mining_force_i.name: Madencilik Gücü I
_base_mining_force_i.description:
Allows drilling and blasting of deeper underground terrain giving you access to previously unreachable resources.

Also allows the Short Range Scanner to scan for artifacts hidden in areas that require Mining Force I.

_base_mining_force_ii.name: Madencilik Gücü II
_base_mining_force_ii.description:
Allows drilling and blasting of deeper underground terrain giving you access to previously unreachable resources.

Also allows the Short Range Scanner to scan for artifacts hidden in areas that require Mining Force II.

_base_mining_robot_i.name: Miner Robot Assembly
_base_mining_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Miner Robots in assembly lines.

_base_modular_fluid_tank.name: Modular Storage Tank
_base_modular_fluid_tank.description: A modular building to store large amounts of liquids and gases.

_base_monument.name: Anıt
_base_monument.description: Kendinizin büyük bir dekoratif heykeli - çünkü harikasınız ve bunu hak ediyorsunuz!

_base_neon_decor.name: Neon Decor
_base_neon_decor.description: Unlocks a set of decorative neon-tube blocks. Use the Paint Roller to change the color!

_base_office_blocks_deluxe_ii.name: Mermer Blokları
_base_office_blocks_deluxe_ii.description: Desteğiniz için teşekkür ederiz, fabrikanızı muhteşem mermerlerle güzelleştirin!

_base_office_furniture_deluxe.name: Executive Office Furniture
_base_office_furniture_deluxe.description: Desteğiniz için teşekkür ederiz, yönetici yaşam tarzının tadını çıkarın!

_base_olumite_fuel.name: Olumit Yakıtı
_base_olumite_fuel.description: Olumit'i sıvı yakıt ve yanıcıların yapımında kullanılan Düşük Yoğunluklu Olumit'e rafine edin.

_base_ore_refinement_i.name: Maden İşleme
_base_ore_refinement_i.description: Verimliliği arttırmak için madenlerin rafine edilebilmesinin kilidini açın.

_base_ore_scanner_ignium.name: Cevher Tarayıcı: Ignium
_base_ore_scanner_ignium.description:
Maden tarayıcı el aleti ile Ignium Madeni'nin taranabilmesinin kilidini açın.

Ignium elektrik üretiminde kullanılan, yanıcı bir madendir. Yakıt olarak kullanabilmek için Brülör Jeneratörü'nü araştırın.

_base_ore_scanner_mineral_rock.name: Cevher Tarayıcı: Mineral Taş
_base_ore_scanner_mineral_rock.description: Mineral açısından zengin, kullanışlı bir kaya olan Mineral Kaya'nın tarayıcı ile aranabilmesinin kilidini açar.

_base_ore_vein_scanner.name: Ore Scanner: XF, TE, IG & MR Veins
_base_ore_vein_scanner.description: Unlocks the ore scanner ability to detect Xenoferrite, Technum, Ignium and Mineral Rock ore veins.

_base_ore_vein_scanner_telluxite.name: Ore Scanner: Telluxite Veins
_base_ore_vein_scanner_telluxite.description: Unlocks the ore scanner ability to detect Telluxite ore veins. Ore veins are large underground resources which can be accessed through the "Underground Mining" technology.

_base_personal_assistant_robot_i.name: Personal Assistant Robot Assembly
_base_personal_assistant_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Personal Assistant robots in assembly lines.

_base_pipelines.name: Boru Hattı
_base_pipelines.description: Boru hatları, borulara yüksek verimli bir alternatif sağlar. Esas olarak Yüksek Fırınlar ve Sıcak Hava Ocakları gibi modüler binalar için gereklidirler. Adaptör parçaları aracılığıyla borulara bağlanabilirler.

_base_power_pole_ii.name: Elektrik Direği (Büyük)
_base_power_pole_ii.description: Uzun mesafeler kat edebilen daha büyük bir elektrik direği.

_base_power_pole_iii.name: Elektrik Direği (Duvar Tipi)
_base_power_pole_iii.description: Duvarlara monte edilebilen küçük bir elektrik direği.

_base_pumpjack_efficiency.name: Sondaj Verimliliği
_base_pumpjack_efficiency.description: Sondaj pompalarının çıktısını seviye başına 10% arttırır. Bu artış, rezervlerin daha hızlı tükenmesine neden olmaz. Tekrar tekrar araştırılabilir.

_base_pumpjack_efficiency_i.name: Pumpjack Efficiency (1)
_base_pumpjack_efficiency_i.description: Increases the resource output of pumpjacks by 10% per level. Extra liquid produced does not deplete the reservoir. Can be researched repeatedly.

_base_recycler_terrain.name: Resource Separator
_base_recycler_terrain.description: Unlocks the Resource Separator, a machine which converts terrain blocks and similar items into more valuable resources while destroying them. Not every item destroyed yields something.

_base_robot_components.name: Robot Bileşenleri
_base_robot_components.description: This research unlocks pre-assembled robot parts for usage in Assembly Lines.

_base_rubber_production.name: Rubber Production
_base_rubber_production.description: Unlocks the ability to create Rubber from Olumite, which is required for different high-tech appliances.

_base_science_bot_i.name: Science Assistant Drone Assembly
_base_science_bot_i.description: Allows the production of Science Asisstant Drones.

_base_science_bot_ii.name: Marine Exploration Bot Assembly
_base_science_bot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Marine Exploration Bots.

_base_science_pack_ii.name: Bilimsel Paket II
_base_science_pack_ii.description: Daha ileri teknolojilerin araştırılabileceği yeni bir Bilimsel Paket tipi.

_base_science_pack_iii.name: Bilimsel Paket III
_base_science_pack_iii.description: Daha ileri teknolojilerin araştırılabileceği yeni bir Bilimsel Paket tipi.

_base_science_pack_iv.name: Bilim Paketi IV
_base_science_pack_iv.description: A new type of science pack to unlock more advanced technology.

_base_science_pack_v.name: Bilim Paketi V
_base_science_pack_v.description: A new type of science pack to unlock more advanced technology.

_base_science_robot_i.name: Science Robot Assembly
_base_science_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Science Robots in assembly lines.

_base_scout_robot_i.name: Scout Robot Assembly
_base_scout_robot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Scout Robots in assembly lines.

_base_screen_bot_i.name: Screen Bot Assembly
_base_screen_bot_i.description: Allows the production of Screen Bots, which are commonly used throughout the galaxy.

_base_shaped_charge_t1.name: Shaped Charge
_base_shaped_charge_t1.description:
A shaped charge is an explosive which focuses all its energy in a certain direction. They are like regular explosives but due to their precision you know exactly which area will be excavated or destroyed in advance.

Trigger them with the detonator just like the throwable explosive charges.

_base_shaped_charge_t2.name: Shaped Charge (Heavy)
_base_shaped_charge_t2.description: A stronger version of the shaped charge which has a larger explosion area and the ability to clear lava cave bedrock and empty reservoirs.

_base_sign.name: İşaretler
_base_sign.description: Fabrika bölümlerinizi isimlendirebilmeniz için duvar veya yere monte edilebilen işaretler.

_base_slag_reprocessing.name: Slag Reprocessing
_base_slag_reprocessing.description: Unlocks methods to convert slag into useful resources.

_base_snack_bot_i.name: Snack Bot Assembly
_base_snack_bot_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce snack bots.

_base_solar_panel_ii.name: Güneş Paneli (Büyük)
_base_solar_panel_ii.description: Daha çok güç üretebilen ve panelleri güneşin açısına göre dönebilen bir güneş paneli.

_base_space_ship_fuel.name: Space Ship Fuel Production
_base_space_ship_fuel.description: Unlocks the production methods required to make space ship fuel and the Refueling Depot on the space station.

_base_space_station_antenna.name: Station: Antenna
_base_space_station_antenna.description: Unlocks the necessary blueprints to repair the space station antenna. This allows us to contact other entities in the galaxy.

_base_space_station_hull_improvements_i.name: Station: Hull Improvements
_base_space_station_hull_improvements_i.description: By improving the structural integrity of our station's hull we can further extend it and build more upgrades. This research unlocks the corresponding station upgrade.

_base_space_station_hull_improvements_ii.name: Station: Hull Expansion
_base_space_station_hull_improvements_ii.description: By extending the hull we can make more space for station upgrades.

_base_space_station_orbital_laser_i.name: Station: Orbital Laser
_base_space_station_orbital_laser_i.description:
By installing an orbital laser we can rapidly destroy a lot of terrain, but it'll be pretty messy.

Use the orbital uplink tool to control it.

_base_space_station_terminal.name: Space Station Terminal
_base_space_station_terminal.description: By combining two emergency beacons we might be able to build a terminal capable of making contact to the orbital station.

_base_station_radio_tower.name: Radyo Kulesi
_base_station_radio_tower.description: Building a large radio tower allows us to contact the space station from anywhere without needing to go to a terminal.

_base_super_alloy_production.name: Superalloy Production
_base_super_alloy_production.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Superalloys, which are a durable metal beams of the highest grade. Also unlocks the production of High-Tech Machinery Parts.

_base_tank.name: Tank
_base_tank.description: Sıvı ve gazları depolayabilmemize imkan sağlar.

_base_trains.name: Trains
_base_trains.description: Unlocks trains and everything related for long distance cargo transportation.

_base_transport_bot_ii.name: Heavy Duty Transport Bot Assembly
_base_transport_bot_ii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce heavy duty transport bots.

_base_transport_bot_iii.name: Aquatic Hauling Bot Assembly
_base_transport_bot_iii.description: Unlocks the ability to produce Aquatic Hauling Bot.

_base_transport_drone_assembly.name: Transport Bot Assembly & Shipping
_base_transport_drone_assembly.description: Unlocks the ability to produce transportation bots and shipping pads to move them to the space station.

_base_transport_drone_i.name: Transport Drone Assembly
_base_transport_drone_i.description: Unlocks the ability to produce transport drones, which come in handy when cargo needs to be transported by air.

_base_underground_mining_i.name: Underground Mining
_base_underground_mining_i.description: Advanced mining equipment to be used with ore veins.

_base_underwater_chassis_i.name: Nautical Chassis
_base_underwater_chassis_i.description: Unlocks nautical bot chassis, which are the basis for various aquatic bots.

_base_walkway.name: Yürüme Platformları
_base_walkway.description: Fabrikanızın belli bölgelerine kolayca ulaşmak ya da kuş bakışı görüş sağlamak için yürüme platformlarını kullanın. Trabzanlar otomatik inşa edilir. Büyük binaların yürüme platformlarına bağlantı yapılabilir.

_base_workstation_i.name: Robot Workstations I
_base_workstation_i.description:
Workstations allow robots to work in your factory and improve various machines.

Check the robot tooltips to see which bonus each provides (only displayed after this has been researched).

_base_workstation_ii.name: Robot Workstations II
_base_workstation_ii.description: Unlocks a better workstation where more robots can work simultaneously.

_base_workstation_iii.name: Robot Workstations III
_base_workstation_iii.description: Unlocks a better workstation where more robots can work simultaneously.

_base_xeno_power_plant.name: Xeno Power Plant
_base_xeno_power_plant.description: Unlocks multiple modular buildings that together form the Xeno Power Plant. While complex to construct, it provides an immense amount of power.
